english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person’s warm character or a friendly manner, such as a smile.

exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 go3 siu3 jung4 hou2 jau5 sin6

english.note: Use this for the friendly, approachable side of being kind.

exampleSentences.english: They’re very kind to the neighbors.
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 gaai1 fong1 hou2 jau5 sin6

english.note: Choose this when “nice” specifically describes someone as friendly and well-disposed toward others.

exampleSentences.english: The new neighbour is very nice to people.
exampleSentences.jyutping: san1 leon4 geoi1 deoi3 jan4 hou2 jau5 sin6
